children: Daiichi Sankyo voluntarily withdrew the U.S. accelerated approval BLA for ifinatamab deruxtecan in previously treated ES-SCLC after FDA said current data, including from phase 2 IDeate-Lung01, do not support approval. Enrollment continues in the phase 3 IDeate-Lung02 trial.
Removes a near-term U.S. approval catalyst; bearish for timelines and revenue expectations.
Signals regulatory and efficacy/safety bar not met with current dataset.
Key dataset underpinning filing fell short for accelerated approval.
Next potential catalyst; positive results would be needed for refiling.
Impacts partner program optics; limited near-term revenue upside for both.

This is a setback in an early regulatory push for a potential first-in-class B7-H3 ADC in ES-SCLC within Daiichi Sankyo’s ADC strategy. A positive phase 3 IDeate-Lung02 readout enabling a new filing would be needed to revive the thesis and reintroduce near-term catalysts.
